diagnosis: The bot is roughly break-even overall (50.7% WR, -$68.37 over 404 trades) but the aggregate masks a clear structural problem: the MOMENTUM setup (383 of 404 trades, 95% of volume) is a net loser at 49% WR and -$55.81, while ARB (13 trades, 92% WR, +$5.89) is strongly profitable but massively under-deployed. Lesson-bucket data pinpoints the leak precisely: the 'move10-20' bps bucket is -$33.47 over 81 trades (34.6% WR) and is now correctly vetoed, and recent decision logs confirm this veto is firing repeatedly and correctly skipping bad setups. However 'price<0.45' (-$19.54, 30.6% WR) and 'left60-120' (-$20.25, 35.6% WR) are also validated-veto but conditions suggest exposure continues elsewhere. Coin-level performance is highly divergent: BTC is the only clear winner (60% WR, +$10.83 over 77 trades) while DOGE is the worst (39% WR, -$23.45 over 71 trades) and ETH/SOL/XRP all bleed modestly. This is a coin-selection/signal-quality issue, not a universal edge problem. Stop-losses are frequently triggering shortly after entry (e.g., stop loss @0.22-0.25 within 90s of a 0.55-0.60 entry), suggesting momentum entries are catching reversals rather than true continuation — likely due to insufficient real move magnitude (many entries are happening on 6-10bps moves, inside or near the vetoed/weak zone) and a momentum_window_sec that may be too short to filter noise from signal. The 'move20+' bucket is the one genuinely profitable momentum zone (+$10.14, 55.8% WR), implying the min_move_bps threshold is currently far too permissive at 25bps relative to what's needed for edge (should push closer to real signal zone, away from the 10-20 dead zone). The 'all-agree' peer-confirmation bucket is surprisingly net negative (-$18.99, 44.6% WR) and flagged reduce_confidence, meaning peer agreement count is not a reliable confidence signal in its current form — likely overconfidence bias inflating position sizing/frequency for all-agree setups that don't actually have higher win probability. The 'left120+' bucket is the strongest time-based edge (+$10.77, 50.3% WR over 175 trades) while left60-120 is firmly negative, meaning the bot should concentrate exposure in markets with >120s remaining and avoid the 60-120s window entirely.
